source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.3.2, printed pages 232-233 (PDF 235-236). The receptor diagram and opiate/opioid note are our aids.

blocks.text: Opiates dawaiyon ki aik class (qisam) hai jo opium poppy (afeem ke paude) se aati hain. Yeh powerful pain relievers (dard ko taqat se door karne wali) hain, lekin addiction (nasha) bhi paida karti hain. Legal (qanooni) dawaiyon mein morphine, codeine, oxycodone, hydrocodone waghera shamil hain. Illegal (ghair qanooni) category mein heroin, fentanyl waghera jaisi drugs aati hain.

blocks.title: Opiates aur opioids
blocks.text: Asal mein opiates afeem ke natural (qudrati) compounds hain (morphine, codeine). Oxycodone, hydrocodone aur heroin in se banaye jaate hain, aur fentanyl poori tarah lab mein bana (synthetic) hai; in sab ko opioids kehte hain. Fentanyl doctor ke prescription (nuskhe) wali legal dawa bhi hai (maslan operation mein anaesthesia ke waqt), agarche illegal taur par bhi bechi jaati hai.
Concept of Opioid Receptors (opioid receptors ka idea)

blocks.title: Endorphins
blocks.text: Insaan ka dimagh apne painkillers (dard door karne wali cheezein) khud banata hai jinhein endorphins kehte hain. Yeh hamare Central Nervous System (CNS, dimagh aur spinal cord ka system) mein opioid receptors se jurti hain. Opiates is natural (qudrati) system ko “hijack” (qabza) kar lete hain: yeh dard door karte hain magar bohat addictive (nasha lagane wale) bhi hain.

Opioid receptors teen qisam ke hain. Mu (μ) receptors dimagh aur spinal cord (haram maghz) mein hote hain. Morphine jaise zyada tar opioids ka primary target (asal nishana) yahi hain. Opiates ka dard door karne wala asar (analgesic activity) inhi se hota hai, lekin in ke active hone se respiratory depression (saans ka sust ho jana) aur intense euphoria (be-had khushi ka nasha) bhi ho sakta hai. Kappa (κ) receptors spinal analgesia (spinal cord ke level par dard rokna) aur sedation (ghunoodgi, neend jaisi susti) mein hissa lete hain, lekin euphoria se in ka talluq kam hai. Delta (δ) receptors emotional response (jazbaat) aur mood regulation (mood ko qaboo mein rakhna) mein ahem kirdar ada karte hain.
Mechanism of Action (kaam karne ka tareeqa)

blocks.title: Opioid receptors
blocks.text: Opiates dimagh aur spinal cord ke kuch special (khaas) proteins se jur kar kaam karte hain; in proteins ko opioid receptors kehte hain.

Yeh key (chaabi = opiate) aur lock (taala = receptor) model ki tarah kaam karta hai. Jab opiate receptor se jurta hai to dard ke signals ko dimagh tak pohanchne se rok deta hai, is liye insaan ko dard kam mehsoos hota hai. Asal mein jab opiate receptor se jurta hai to calcium channels band ho jaate hain aur potassium channel khul jaata hai. Is se neuron (nerve cell) hyperpolarize ho jata hai (us ke andar ka charge aur zyada negative ho jaata hai), aur cell ke liye dard ka signal aage bhejna bohat mushkil ho jata hai. Experiments (tajurbaat) se pata chala hai ke opiates dimagh ke reward center (khushi mehsoos karane wale hisse) mein aik neurochemical reaction shuru karte hain, jis se dopamine bohat zyada release hoti (nikalti) hai, aur relief (sukoon) aur well-being (khushi) ka ehsaas hota hai.

blocks.alt: Nerve-cell membrane ki patti: baen taraf receptor (lock) mein opiate (key) jura hai; beech mein Ca2+ channel band ('closed'); daen taraf K+ channel khula jis se K+ bahar nikalta hai ('K+ flows out').
blocks.caption: Opiate ka receptor se jurna: Ca2+ channel band, K+ channel khula (hamari drawing; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen: opiate (key) receptor (lock) mein fit ho kar jurta hai. Is ke baad beech wala Ca²⁺ channel band ho jaata hai, is liye Ca²⁺ andar nahi aata; daen wala K⁺ channel khulta hai aur K⁺ bahar nikalta hai. Neuron ke andar charge aur negative ho jaata hai (hyperpolarization), is liye dard ka signal aage nahi jaa pata.

Opioids acute pain (achanak aur thori der ka dard) door karne ke liye use hote hain. Cancer ke severe (shadeed) dard ko manage (qaboo) karne mein bhi in ka istemal hota hai. Codeine jaise opioids cough syrups (khansi ke sharbat) mein dale jaate hain kyunke yeh cough reflex (khud-ba-khud khansi aana) dabate hain. Yeh gastrointestinal tract (maida aur aantein) ke receptors se jur kar digestion (hazme) ko sust karte hain aur diarrhea (dast) mein aaram de sakte hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Street drug (sarak par bikne wala nasha) banne se pehle Heroin (diacetylmorphine) Bayer company ki trademark dawa thi, jo morphine ke “non-addictive” (nasha na karne wale) alternative (badal) aur bachon ki cough suppressant (khansi rokne wali dawa) ke taur par bechi jaati thi. Is ki potency (taqat) morphine se taqreeban paanch guna hai, aur yeh blood-brain barrier (khoon aur dimagh ke beech ki rukawat) jaldi paar karti thi, jis se aik “rush” (achanak nasha) paida hota tha. Isi se poori duniya mein addiction epidemic (nashe ki waba) phail gayi.

blocks.prompt: Morphine ka asal nishana kaun sa opioid receptor hai, aur is ke active hone se kaun se side effects ho sakte hain?
blocks.explanation: Mu (μ) receptor. Dard door karne ke saath yeh saans ki susti (respiratory depression) aur shadeed euphoria bhi paida kar sakta hai.

items: Opiates afeem se aate hain; dard door karte hain magar addictive hain.
Endorphins jism ke apne painkillers hain; opiates unhi receptors ko hijack karte hain.
Teen receptors: Mu (dard, saans ki susti, euphoria), Kappa (spinal analgesia, sedation), Delta (mood).
Ca²⁺ channels band, K⁺ channel khula: neuron hyperpolarize, dard ka signal ruk jata hai.
Istemal: acute aur cancer ka dard, khansi (codeine), dast.
